subject: DeepSeek suspended as a run model (answers TAA Q-05 and finding TAA-FND-03)
statements: stop using deepseek at all, just resume when I say so
I dont have more credits for deepseek, don use it
replace deepseek by other model, claude or codex by now
decision: No agent node runs on DeepSeek until the owner says otherwise. Authors run on Codex Sol 6.1 and the inspectors and the Release Manager on Claude Opus 5.5 (OD-2026-10-19-06/08). config/factory/model-suspensions.yaml lists the provider; workorder.run refuses a DeepSeek run unless every agent node is on an ACP backend.
finding: CAPA-051: the swe4_test_author node (all runs) and swe3_hal_author (LL+HAL runs) were never moved to Codex because their prompts span several lines; they ran on DeepSeek in every Codex-author run, including the runs behind the signed RCC documents. The signed tool assurance assessment TAA-RCC-001 records swe4_test_author on DeepSeek (T-03) but not swe3_hal_author; its statement that authors run on Codex is incomplete for the HAL author.
not_changed: The signed documents are not edited (they are hash-pinned); the TAA finding stays for the owner. The cloud benchmark Fabro server keeps deepseek-flash as its configured default model, which serves no agent node.
